nodes.label: Deletion Paging Watermark Caveat
nodes.rationale: A deletion row may become visible after a later deletionId has already been read, so consumers should restart from zero with an overlapping deletedAfter window and deduplicate IDs.

nodes.label: Deleted Entity Tracking Tables and Triggers
nodes.norm_label: deleted entity tracking tables and triggers

nodes.label: Database Modification Watermark
nodes.rationale: Database triggers maintain the plugin-owned modification timestamp because Leantime does not update its modified column on every write path.

nodes.label: Custom TimeTable Repository
nodes.rationale: The custom repository supplies datasets that the existing API does not support.

nodes.label: Repository-Level Project Access Scoping
nodes.rationale: Enforcing project-access scoping in the repository SQL layer prevents the query layer from relying on callers to enforce access.

nodes.label: Docker Secrets for Sensitive Configuration
nodes.rationale: Docker secrets provide an alternative to passing supported sensitive values through environment variables.
